news.headline: Back at practice again, Bengals QB Burrow optimistic he'll be at full strength
news.description: A full participant at practice for the second straight day despite the bug that he has battled, Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is optimistic that he'll be at full strength when Cincinnati plays the Washington Commanders on "Monday Night Football."

news.headline: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) listed as questionable
news.description: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Denver Broncos, coach Klint Kubiak said Friday.

news.headline: Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) cleared to start vs. Chargers

news.headline: Police investigate man's death after alleged altercation at 49ers-Cowboys game
news.description: Police are investigating the death of a man who was allegedly involved in an altercation before Sunday's game between the Cowboys and 49ers at AT&T Stadium.

news.headline: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid doubtful to play vs. Dolphins
news.description: Bills starting tight end Dalton Kincaid, their leading receiver, is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins due to thumb and ankle injuries.

news.headline: Justin Reid posts Saints farewell as team releases safety
news.description: The Saints have granted Justin Reid's request to be released, with the safety posting on social media: "In life and sports, things don't always go the way you planned or hoped they would."

transactions.text: Placed LB Jack Campbell on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the active roster. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas and RB Jabari Small from the practice squad.
Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.
